counterfactual_missing_items: no clear evidence of basaloid nests
The diagnosis was rendered as invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma based on the excisional biopsy results.
decisive_items: An excisional biopsy of the lesion showed lobules and detached aggregates of eosinophilic keratinocytes with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli infiltrating the reticular dermis; there was no clear evidence of basaloid nests, and the diagnosis rendered was invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
response.rationale: The excisional biopsy results and the initial diagnosis of invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma take precedence over the later dermoscopic evaluation of papules revealing features typical of basal cell carcinoma, suggesting the possibility of a second, separate diagnosis rather than a single diagnosis of basal cell carcinoma.

rejected.why: later dermoscopic evaluation does not override initial biopsy diagnosis
